A 24/7 online employment center and integrated digital platform that unifies previously fragmented online service channels and administrative functions into one system. 1. Background The Ministry of Employment and Labor has been operating a variety of online employment services, including job placement (WorkNet), unemployment benefits and employment incentives (Employment Insurance), and vocational training (HRD-Net). As a result, users had to navigate multiple platforms to access employment services, often dealing with inconvenient and complex procedures that mirrored traditional paper-based forms. In contrast, countries like France and Germany are shifting toward digital employment services that go beyond simply providing job information, using big data and AI to deliver personalized job and training recommendations. France’s public employment agency, Pôle Emploi, began a major digital transformation in 2012 and invested €455 million (approximately KRW 541 billion) over three years starting in 2018. Following this global trend, Korea launched Employment24—a next-generation digital employment platform that integrates systems like WorkNet and leverages technologies such as AI to provide tailored services. 2. Progress to Date ISP(Information Strategy Planning) in 2021 → Service Provider Selected in September 2022 → Development of Employment24 Began in October 2022 Phased rollout of key services began in November 2023 → Pilot operation launched in March 2024 In September 2024, all online employment services* were consolidated into Employment24 → Official launch completed. * Including WorkNet, Employment Insurance, HRD-Net, Foreign Workforce Management, and the National Employment Support Program. 3. Key Features: “Personalized Employment Services, Made Easy with Employment24” ① Integration of Online Administrative Services By consolidating nine separate online employment services into a single platform, users can now apply for, report, and track services in one place—greatly improving accessibility for the public. ➊ WorkNet, ➋ Employment Insurance, ➌ HRD-Net, ➍ National Employment Support Program, ➎ EPS (Employment Permit System for Foreign Workers), ➏ Youth Jobs, ➐ Youth Tomorrow Savings Program, ➑ SME Youth Job Experience Program, ➒ Youth Challenge Support Program Through information integration, the system reduces the need for supporting documents and data entry by eliminating requirements for information already held by the government. ② Enhanced Personalized Recommendation Services Based on the specific characteristics of individuals and companies, Employment24 offers tailored guidance on likely eligible subsidies, recommends jobs, training, and certifications aligned with job seekers’ skills, and enables businesses to search for and apply for employment support programs directly through their internal ERP systems—without needing to visit Employment24—by linking with private ERP platforms. ③ Efficient Service Processing Using Automated Screening and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) By automating repetitive tasks such as subsidy evaluations, mailings, and payment processing, staff efficiency is improved and more time is made available for personalized counseling. ● Key Features and Functions of Employment24 1) Induviduals ‧ Businesses By integrating multiple sites, users can access a wide range of employment services and support with a single login. Individuals can access services such as job placement support, government subsidies, training vouchers (The National Tomorrow Learning Card), unemployment benefits, etc. Businesses can utilize talent recruitment, government subsidies, training programs, and foreign workforce management services, etc. Through personalized recommendation features, users receive tailored information based on their membership profile without needing to search separately. The JobCare function offers competency assessments based on desired occupations and recommends relevant jobs, training, and certifications. The service recommendation feature suggests employment services and subsidies suited to the characteristics of individuals and businesses. Additionally, the labor market information feature provides data such as actual wages by occupation and wage gaps between what employers offer and what workers expect. By streamlining application procedures through data integration, Employment24 reduces input fields, enables pre-screening of eligibility, and minimizes documentation requirements—making the application process simpler and more user-friendly. The Policy Guide feature clearly introduces various support programs tailored to individuals (by stages of employment) and businesses (by stages of HR management). 2) Businesses By offering integration with private ERP systems, Employment24 enables businesses to search for and directly apply for employment subsidies and other support programs within their own ERP platforms. 3) Internal PES Staff The automated subsidy screening feature allows the system to determine eligibility without the need for separate document verification. Through task automation, Employment24 enables automatic online mailing of documents that were previously sent manually and links received e-faxes (such as applications and attachments) directly to the system. The firm banking feature streamlines general accounting payment processes, making financial transactions more efficient. The pilot consultation auto-recording feature uses Speech-to-Text (STT) technology to summarize and document counseling sessions. 4.
